name: Security: AI Platform Audit
description: Fuehrt Garak-Sicherheitsprobing (Prompt Injection, Leakage) gegen einen LLM- oder OpenAI-kompatiblen Endpoint aus. Intrusiv — benoetigt explizite Freigabe.

config.prompt: Run the security workflow 'ai_platform_audit' by calling security_workflow_run with workflow_id='ai_platform_audit' and target_id='{target_id}'. This uses an intrusive scanner and will likely pause with status waiting_for_approval — explain that to the user and report the scan_run_id they need to approve.
